God is with me, I do not fear.

s47/ellu_devarim.primary: אלו The following matters have no legal measure: The corner of the field, the first fruits, the pilgrimage, the practice of charity and study of the Torah. With regard to the following matters, man receives an income in this world and the capital is stored for him in the future world: honouring father and mother, the practice of charity, early attendance in the House of Study mornings and evenings, hospitality towards strangers, care of the sick, endowment of a bride, escorting the dead, concentration during prayer, peace making between man and his fellow man with the study of the Torah outweighing all of them.

s47/elohai_neshamah.primary: אלהי My God, the soul which Thou hast given me is pure. Thou didst create it, Thou didst form it, Thou didst breathe it into me and preserve it within me. Thou wilt eventually take it from me and restore it to me in the future world. As long as the soul is within me I thank Thee, O Lord my God, and God of my fathers, Lord of all works, Master of all souls. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who returns souls to dead bodies.
